# Philemon

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Philemon demonstrates the transforming power of the gospel through forgiveness, reconciliation, and Christian brotherhood.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Philemon 1:16</div>

<div class="identifier">No longer as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved</div>

### Why This Verse

Central message of reconciliation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter is Paul's personal appeal for Onesimus, a runaway slave who became a believer. The key verse emphasizes reconciliation, forgiveness, and receiving a fellow believer as a beloved brother in Christ.
:::
